scope: Development findings; verified_fix requires current exported-byte evidence.

incidents.observed_problem: Official validator rejects empty children arrays on leaf nodes.
incidents.diagnosed_cause: Exporter emitted children:[] on leaf nodes.
incidents.candidate_fix: Builder reports omitting children when empty.
incidents.unresolved: Production and photographic acceptance remain separate.

incidents.candidate_fix: Builder reports restoring tangent.w to exact+1/-1 and normalizing XYZ.
incidents.unresolved: Production and photographic acceptance remain separate.

incidents.candidate_fix: Builder applied local cabin-rib relief and narrowly bounded outer ramp-flange trimming/caps; final sampled triangles no longer show the diagnosed crossings.

verified_fix.execution_provenance: Original actual triangle test retained; current indexing explicitly proved exactly equivalent in exact_indexing_equivalence.json.

incidents.unresolved: Full continuous clearance, containment, coplanar overlap and unenumerated pairs remain unproved; perimeter seams and declared attachment interfaces are retained.

incidents.observed_problem: Generated sensor sphere poles contained 192 zero-area faces in each gunship variant.
incidents.diagnosed_cause: Generated latitude-longitude sphere retained collapsed pole triangles.
incidents.candidate_fix: Builder removed generated sphere pole degenerates.
incidents.unresolved: Photographic surface quality is not established by absence of degenerate faces.

incidents.observed_problem: A clipped fuselage sliver collapsed after float32 export quantization.
incidents.diagnosed_cause: Source precision face area was nonzero but stored float32 coordinates made the triangle degenerate.
incidents.candidate_fix: Builder filters triangle area using actual float32 export positions.
incidents.unresolved: Photographic surface quality is not established by absence of degenerate faces.

incidents.observed_problem: FLYING gear covers clear sampled surfaces but do not fully close their wells: substantial nose gaps and visible main well side walls.
incidents.diagnosed_cause: Nose aft cover has insufficient longitudinal footprint in its authored closed pose; extracted forward hatches leave a gap. Main bottom closure covers 99.4% of surveyed mouth but the broad well cut/box exposes side walls.
incidents.candidate_fix: Retain original outer main fairing, fit wheel receiving corridor and eliminate outboard well wall; fit preserved original aft nose panel to original hole with staged forward slide and lift. Remove the added bridge.

verified_fix.retained_seams: Small inner/perimeter seams remain visible and are accepted for draft presentation only.

incidents.unresolved: No watertight, photographic or full continuous-clearance acceptance is claimed.

incidents.observed_problem: Upper cargo door shares triangle crossings with fuselage within a declared 50 mm hinge-axis attachment region.
incidents.diagnosed_cause: Builder declares a preserved leaf attachment interface, with contact retained rather than hidden by a blanket tolerance.
incidents.candidate_fix: No automatic deletion of attachment geometry; require explicit native inspection and scoped acceptance of the interface.
incidents.unresolved: A declared 50 mm hinge region is not independently certified continuous clearance. Native viewing and explicit draft scope remain required.
incidents.native_review_note: Final exact-hash service-cargo views inspected; the declared attachment interface remains scoped and is not a full clearance certificate.

incidents.observed_problem: First gear-closure repair restored inner fuselage surfaces into the main-wheel travel corridor and left new nose hatch tip contacts; well walls also protruded outside restored side skin.
incidents.diagnosed_cause: Keeping all original skin above the wheel-opening sill also kept inner shell surfaces crossed by vertically translating wheels. Rectangular well wall extended 15–35 mm outboard of the source skin at representative X-depth rays.
incidents.candidate_fix: Builder separating outer sponson skin from the inner wheel corridor and refitting the bounded well geometry; forward hatch lip sweep also requires localized review.

verified_fix.execution_provenance: Original actual triangle test retained; current indexing explicitly proved exactly equivalent in exact_indexing_equivalence.json.

incidents.unresolved: Full continuous clearance, containment, coplanar overlap and unenumerated pairs remain unproved; perimeter seams and declared attachment interfaces are retained.

incidents.observed_problem: The corrected original nose panel still crossed restored skin at the .95 closing stage; the forward hatch clipped its arbitrary aft extraction lip at .875.
incidents.diagnosed_cause: Aft panel forward/up movement occurred together before reaching the original opening; a forward leaf had an artificial clipping edge and clearing translation.
incidents.candidate_fix: Finish forward slide/tilt before final lift; use the natural original forward leaf edge and fitted source-only hinge.
incidents.unresolved: Only declared sampled poses are proved; full continuous clearance is not certified.
